headlines.title: 法国失业率小幅下降 令疲弱的经济稍获喘息
headlines.summary: 法国第三季度失业率略有下降，这给正面临抗议活动和预算不确定性等不利因素、并濒临衰退的经济带来些许缓解。法国统计部门Insee表示，第三季度失业率从上一季度的8.3%降至8.2%，预期为升至8.4%。法国央行周一表示，经济增速将在2026年最后一个季度“温和”回升，但同时警告称，存在异常高的不确定性，未给出精确的估计。Insee的数据显示，15-24岁人群的失业率下降至21%，而50岁以上人群的失业率略微上升至5.6%，为2022年初以来的最高水平。

headlines.title_en: French unemployment rate edges down, giving the weak economy some respite
headlines.summary_en: France's unemployment rate edged down in the third quarter, offering some relief to an economy that is on the brink of recession and facing headwinds including protests and budget uncertainty. French statistics agency Insee said the unemployment rate fell to 8.2% in the third quarter from 8.3% in the previous quarter, versus expectations for a rise to 8.4%. The Bank of France said on Monday that economic growth would pick up "moderately" in the final quarter of 2026, but warned of exceptionally high uncertainty and did not provide a precise estimate. Insee data showed that the unemployment rate for people aged 15-24 fell to 21%, while the unemployment rate for those over 50 rose slightly to 5.6%, the highest level since early 2022.

headlines.title_en: Former New York Fed chief: US October CPI to cool slightly; after a December hike, the Fed will "rest for a while"!
headlines.summary_en: [Former New York Fed chief: U.S. October CPI to cool slightly; after a December hike, the Fed will "take a break for a while"!] Beijing time tonight, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the U.S. October Consumer Price Index (CPI). Analysts noted that October CPI may show some easing in price pressures, in line with economists' expectations. But according to Christopher Hodge, chief U.S. economist at Natixis, while there is little evidence that U.S. inflation is re-accelerating, the path back to the Fed's target does not look smooth, and after another rate hike in December the Fed will "take a break for a while."

Robot-related stocks were active, with Fenglong, Guangyang, Tianqi, and Xiangyang Bearing hitting the daily limit. On the downside, oil and gas stocks fell collectively, with PetroChina down more than 6%. headlines.title_en: Hong Kong market close: Hang Seng Index up 0.44%, Hang Seng Tech Index up 1.08%
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong stocks closed with the Hang Seng Index up 0.44% and the Hang Seng Tech Index up 1.08%. The Hang Seng Stock Connect ETF Yinhua (159318) fell 0.08%, and the Stock Connect Technology ETF Penghua (159751) rose 0.65%. By sector, broadcasting and other energy storage and transportation sectors led gains, while oil products and petrochemicals trading and non-metallic mineral mining III led declines. Among individual stocks, Xinde Semiconductor rose 28.38%, Wangshan Wangshui-B gained 17.46%, Baige Online rose 17.2%, Tianshu Zhixin gained 15.49%, and MOMENTA-W rose 14.35%; SITC fell 7.83%, Denglin Technology-P dropped 7.79%, Chuangxin Industrial fell 6.28%, COSCO Shipping Energy dropped 5.51%, and Aluminum Corporation of China fell 4.91%.

headlines.title: 美国企业对特定光谱流式细胞仪系统及其组件提起337调查申请
headlines.summary: 【美国企业对特定光谱流式细胞仪系统及其组件提起337调查申请】商务部公告，2026年10月8日，美国Cytek Biosciences, Inc.根据《美国1930年关税法》第337节规定向美国国际贸易委员会提出申请，指控对美出口、在美进口及销售的特定光谱流式细胞仪系统及其组件侵犯其专利权，请求发起337调查，并发布有限排除令和禁止令。美国、中国两家企业涉案。

headlines.title_en: US companies file Section 337 investigation application over certain spectral flow cytometry systems and components
headlines.summary_en: [U.S. company files Section 337 complaint over certain spectral flow cytometry systems and components] The Ministry of Commerce announced that on October 8, 2026, Cytek Biosciences, Inc. of the United States filed an application with the U.S. International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the U.S. Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain spectral flow cytometry systems and components exported to, imported into, and sold in the United States infringe its patent rights, and requesting the initiation of a Section 337 investigation and the issuance of a limited exclusion order and a cease and desist order. Two companies from the United States and China are involved.
